title: Substrate provisioner settings
description: Strict TOML configuration for cloud/substrate.toml. The serve password comes only from GANJA_CLOUD_PASSWORD; it is not a file setting. The Basic-auth user comes from [cloud].username in ganja.toml and must match the worker's GANJA_SERVER_USERNAME (serve defaults to ganja).

kubeconfig.description: Operator-owned kubeconfig; never copied into a worker.

template.description: Existing template whose golden snapshot must be ready.

service_account.description: API identity in the fixed ate-users namespace.

api_service.description: Service route in ate-system; serving identity remains api.ate-system.svc.

router_service.description: Service route in ate-system; serving identity remains atenet-router.ate-system.svc.

git_credential_uri.description: Gateway credential reference containing a provider name and provider-specific tail.

kubectl.description: Absolute path to the released kubectl executable. Used only when tunnel is explicitly kubectl, with router_service set to atenet-router; never an automatic fallback. Plugin resolution still trusts PATH and HOME, and the plugin's fixed-actor loopback socket has no proxy-token check.
